// Package fx is a fixture.
package fx

// T is a type.
type T[K comparable] struct{}

type t struct{}

// Plain has a doc.
func Plain() {}

// Results has unparenthesized results.
func Results(a int) error {
	if a > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	for i := 0; i < a; i++ {
		defer func() {
			if i > 0 {
				return
			}
		}()
	}
	switch {
	case a > 1:
		return fmt.Errorf("x")
	}
	return func() error { return nil }()
}

// Method is on an exported pointer receiver.
func (r *T[K]) Method(k K) (n int, err error) {
	select {
	case <-make(chan int):
		return 1, nil
	}
	return
}

// Hidden is on an unexported receiver.
func (r t) Hidden() {}

// Bodiless has no body.
func Bodiless() int

// unexported is not exported.
func unexported() {}

/* Block doc */
// continues.
func (T[K]) Value() int {
	if v := func() int { return 1 }(); v > 0 {
		return v
	} else if v < 0 {
		return -v
	}
	return 0
}

func NoDoc() {}
